- SUPRA/SUPRAOJOHomeView.swift contains navigation title "SUPRA × ojO · FRANCE V1"
- default selection is .france
- detail route .france -> FranceOrganismNativeView()

DO NOW, SEQUENTIALLY:
1) DO NOT mutate or reset any existing user checkout. Build from an isolated temporary source extracted from the exact required_commit using the public GitHub codeload tarball.
2) Verify the exact commit source markers above before building. If any marker is absent, STOP FAIL_BOUNDED.
3) Build the existing SUPRA macOS target Release with the locally installed Xcode/macOS 26 toolchain:
   xcodebuild -project SUPRA.xcodeproj -scheme SUPRA -configuration Release -sdk macosx -derivedDataPath <temp>/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build
4) Require BUILD SUCCEEDED. Do not install on build failure.
5) Ad-hoc sign the just-built SUPRA.app:
   codesign --force --deep --sign - --timestamp=none <built SUPRA.app>
   then codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=4.
6) Install ONLY the just-built verified bundle as:
   ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app
   Use ditto. Preserve any existing ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app first as a timestamped rollback beside it. Do not delete unrelated apps.
7) Remove quarantine ONLY from ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app:
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app
8) Close stale running SUPRA/SUPRA-FRANCE instances gracefully if possible; if necessary use bounded pkill -x SUPRA only. Then launch exactly:
   open -n ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app
9) Verify all of:
   - installed path exists
   - codesign --verify passes on installed copy
   - process launches
   - launched executable/bundle resolves from ~/Applications/SUPRA-FRANCE.app (not an older SUPRA.app)
   - strings or source proof includes "SUPRA × ojO · FRANCE V1"
   - source default route is FranceOrganismNativeView()
   - no new bridge/runtime/engine created
10) If Accessibility allows it, read the frontmost SUPRA window title/text and confirm "FRANCE V1" or "France". If Accessibility is denied, do not request Nicolas action; mark UI_VISUAL=UNPROVEN but keep launch proof.
11) Return one material JSON result and stop.
